<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #ccc;
    font-family: sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

#app {
  width: 80%;
  max-width: 1100px;
  height: 95vh;              /* taller vertically */
  margin: 2.5vh auto;
  background: #d5d5d5;
  border-radius: 40px;       /* rounded again */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

  #topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .action-btn {
    width: 120px;
    padding: 12px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #aaa;
    font-size: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }

  .action-btn:hover {
    background: #888;
  }

#content {
  height: 200px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

#waveform {
  width: 2000px; /* can expand dynamically */
  height: 100%;
}

  #controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 20px;
    padding-right: 10px;
  }

  .icon-btn {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    font-size: 26px;
    background: #aaa;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }

  .icon-btn:hover {
    background: #888;
  }
#filename {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #444;
  margin-top: -10px;
  padding-left: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
</style>

<div id="app">
<div id="topbar">
<button class="action-btn" id="uploadBtn">Upload</button>
<button class="action-btn" id="splitBtn">Split</button>
<button class="action-btn" id="clearBtn">Clear</button>
<button class="action-btn" id="downloadBtn">Download</button>
<input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".mp3" style="display:none;">
</div>
<div id="content">
<div id="filename"></div>
<div id="waveform"></div>
</div>
<div id="controls">
<button class="icon-btn" id="pauseBtn">⏸️</button>
<button class="icon-btn" id="playBtn">▶️</button>
<button class="icon-btn" id="stopBtn">⏹️</button>
</div>
</div>


<script src="https://unpkg.com/wavesurfer.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/wavesurfer.js@7/dist/wavesurfer.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/wavesurfer.js@7/dist/plugins/regions.js"></script>



<script>
let wavesurfer;
const fileInput = document.getElementById("fileInput");
const uploadBtn = document.getElementById("uploadBtn");
const content = document.getElementById("content");
const filenameDisplay = document.getElementById("filename");

// Trigger file input
uploadBtn.onclick = () => {
  fileInput.click();
};

// Load MP3 and render waveform
fileInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;

  // Destroy existing waveform
  if (wavesurfer) {
    wavesurfer.destroy();
    wavesurfer = null;
  }

  // Reset content box
  content.innerHTML = '<div id="waveform"></div>';
  filenameDisplay.textContent = "File: " + file.name;

  // Create new waveform
  wavesurfer = WaveSurfer.create({
    container: '#waveform',
    waveColor: '#4a90e2',
    progressColor: '#357ABD',
    height: 180,
    responsive: true,
    scrollParent: true
  });

  // Load the file
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  wavesurfer.load(blobUrl);

  // Reset file input so same file can be reselected
  fileInput.value = null;
});

// Clear everything
document.getElementById("clearBtn").onclick = () => {
  if (wavesurfer) {
    wavesurfer.destroy();
    wavesurfer = null;
  }
  content.innerHTML = '<div id="waveform"></div>';
  filenameDisplay.textContent = "";
  fileInput.value = null;
  alert("Cleared!");
};

// Playback controls
document.getElementById("playBtn").onclick = () => {
  if (wavesurfer) wavesurfer.play();
};
document.getElementById("pauseBtn").onclick = () => {
  if (wavesurfer) wavesurfer.pause();
};
document.getElementById("stopBtn").onclick = () => {
  if (wavesurfer) wavesurfer.stop();
};

// Download placeholder
document.getElementById("downloadBtn").onclick = () => alert("Download clicked");
</script>
